title: Grading Result
description: Output of grading one (eval, condition) pair. Lives at <workspace>/iteration-N/eval-<id>/<condition>/grading.json.

meta_results.description: Framework-injected meta-assertions (e.g. skill-invocation check). Reserved id prefix: __ (double underscore). Tracked separately from substantive assertion_results so they do not pollute the skill effectiveness pass_rate.

assertion_source.description: Which evals.json supplied the assertions above. The treatment is frozen at what ran, but assertions are the measuring instrument and are authored after the dispatch they grade, so the file they came from is recorded rather than assumed. Absent in gradings written before the source was recorded.

path.description: Absolute path to the evals.json the graded assertions came from: the live skill file when it differs from the run-time copy, otherwise the copy the iteration froze.

digest.description: Digest over every graded eval's id, assertions, and skill_should_trigger, so two gradings can be compared without diffing the file.

refreshed.description: True when the live file replaced the assertions the run froze.

skill_invoked.description: True when at least one treatment member's invocation meta-check passed; false when none did; null when no treatment skill was loaded for this run.

skill_name.description: Treatment member checked; absent for scalar legacy artifacts.

id.description: Matches the assertion id in evals.json.

evidence.description: Direct quote or specific reference from the run record. Vague summaries are not evidence.

confidence.description: Judge confidence. Low confidence (< 0.7) flags this result for human review. Always 1.0 for transcript_check results.

id.description: Matches the authored llm_judge assertion id in evals.json.

grader.description: Sampled results are produced only by authored LLM-judge assertions.

judge_samples.description: Every requested verdict in sample-index order. A missing response is retained as a failed sample rather than failing the whole assertion.

pass_power_k.description: proportion raised to total: the estimated probability every requested judgment passes.

pass_rate.description: Compatibility alias for vote_proportion in a sampled grading.

vote_proportion.description: Equal-weight mean of each substantive assertion's binary result or sampled vote proportion.

pass_power_k.description: Equal-weight mean of each substantive assertion's binary result or sampled pass^k value.
